# Payout Wallet - Amazon APIs

You can use our APIs to perform various actions necessary to create payouts. You can perform most of these actions from the [RazorpayX Dashboard](https://x.razorpay.com/auth) as well.

## List of APIs

The table below lists the various endpoints and gives a brief description of each:

API Endpoint | Description
---
[Normal Payout API](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/payout-wallet/create/contact.md) Includes: - [Create a Contact API](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/payout-wallet/create/contact.md)
- [Create a Fund Account of type `wallet` API](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/payout-wallet/create/fund-account.md)
-  [Create a Payout API](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/payout-wallet/create/payout.md)
 | Creates a normal payout to your Contact's Amazon Pay Gift Card. 
---
[Composite Payout API](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/payout-wallet/create/payout-composite.md) | Create a Contact, Fund Account and make the payout to your Contact's Amazon Pay Gift Card at once using [Composite API](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/payout-composite.md).
